statement: Every CA(12; 2, 7, 3) is isomorphic to every other (one class), and no CA(11; 2, 7, 3) exists, so CAN(2, 7, 3) = 12.

cert.independent: matches every v = 3, N = 10 to 12 cell of Kokkala et al., arXiv 1901.03594, Table 1 (including 1 class at k = 7 and 0 at N = 11, k = 6)

literature.best_published: Known: Colbourn, Kéri, Rivas Soriano, Schlage-Puchta (2010); Kokkala et al. (arXiv 1901.03594)
literature.notes: Re-proof of a known result, used as a premise.
